card.name: Linking words before who-gets-the-disease
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right after a disease name, just before a verb like affects or occurs. The sentence is about who or which body part a condition strikes.

modes.label: Relative word after disease
modes.description: A word like that, which or a comma follows a disease name and leads into what it does.

modes.label: Frequency adverb before verb
modes.description: Words like often, mainly or only sit before affects or occurs when describing who or where a disease hits.
modes.example: Paget's disease most<< often>> affects the bones in the pelvis,

card.writes: It pushes the model to write affect, affects or affecting as the next word.
card.plain: It spots the point in a disease description where the next word is likely to be "affects".
